---

Colour codes are marked with a swatch of that colour, in inline code and, when enabled, in prose.

```markdown
The brand colour is `#b22222`, with `rgb(10, 100, 200)` for links.
```

The brand colour is `#b22222`, with `rgb(10, 100, 200)` for links.

Named colours, short hex, `hsl()`, `hwb()`, and the alpha forms are all recognised: `rebeccapurple`, `#F03`, `hsl(240, 100%, 50%)`, `rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5)`.

Scanning of prose is off by default; turn it on with `text: true` under `extensions.preview-colour`.

A colour in inline code has to be the whole of it, so `` `"My colour is #441100"` `` is not marked.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-preview-colour/>.
